meta.name: identify-assumptions-existing
meta.description: Identify risky assumptions for a feature idea in an existing product across Value, Usability, Viability, and Feasibility. Uses multi-perspective devil's advocate thinking. Use when stress-testing a feature idea, doing risk assessment, or preparing for assumption mapping.

copy.tagline: 找出产品功能背后的隐藏假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在新功能上线前识别潜在风险
copy.tagline_en: Uncover hidden assumptions behind feature ideas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify potential risks before launching a new feature

howto.what: 当你描述一个现有产品的新功能想法后，Claude 会从产品经理、设计师、工程师三个角度，分析该功能在价值、可用性、可行性和商业可行性四个方面的潜在风险假设，并给出每个假设的置信度和测试建议。
howto.when: 当你需要压力测试一个功能想法、进行风险评估或准备假设映射时触发。

say.text: 我们想在电商App里加一个AI试衣间功能，请帮我识别其中的风险假设。
say.note: Claude 会分析该功能在四个风险领域的假设。

say.text: 针对这个新功能，从PM、设计师和工程师视角分别列出可能失败的原因。
say.note: Claude 会从三个角色视角进行魔鬼代言人分析。

howto.what_en: After you describe a feature idea for an existing product, Claude analyzes risky assumptions across Value, Usability, Viability, and Feasibility from PM, designer, and engineer perspectives, noting confidence levels and test suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when stress-testing a feature idea, doing risk assessment, or preparing for assumption mapping.

say_en.text: We want to add an AI fitting room feature to our e-commerce app. Please identify risky assumptions.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze assumptions across four risk areas.

say_en.text: For this new feature, list possible failure reasons from PM, designer, and engineer perspectives.
say_en.note: Claude will perform devil's advocate analysis from three roles.
